description: While Washington racks up trillions in debt and prints money to cover its mistakes, Tennessee continues to do something very important: we balance our budget. That matters. A state government should not spend money it does not have, and Tennessee’s commitment to a zero-debt, balanced budget helps keep our state on stronger financial footing than many others across the country.This year, the General Assembly passed a $58.3 billion balanced budget without raising taxes.
